newsitem.title: USA: SunSource to make a cash distribution.
newsitem.headline: SunSource to make a cash distribution.

text.p: SunSource L.P. said Thursday it would make a cash distribution of $0.091666 for December for each Class A limited partnership interest.
The distribution would be for holders of record December 31 and payable January 31, it said.
The company also said the partnership would suspend payment of the monthly, tax-related distributions to Class B interest holders in 1997 in anticipation of its conversion into a corporation.
SunSource supplies value-added services to industrial and retail customers throughout North America.
